about: Labeled corpus for the professional-services beachhead (docs/module5.md §11: Presidio recognizers ≥ 95% recall on PII). Every value is synthetic: fictional people, test card numbers, documentation IBANs, reserved 555 phone numbers and example.com subdomains (RFC 2606). `value` is the exact gold span; `type` is the entity it must be found as (same label class counts).
